Class Pokemon

java.lang.Object
Pokemon
public class Pokemon extends Object
Data model for a Keymon creature.

Stores base stats (HP and attack), the current HP, and a lazy-loaded sprite image. The static pool (getPool()) defines the six creatures available in the game. Gson skips the transient sprite field so it is re-loaded via loadSprite() after deserialisation.
